acceptanceCriteria: A unit test wraps a NotRetryable wire.Error with each annotating helper and asserts the flag is preserved.
Fix lands with the test; callers that classify retryability observe the preserved flag.
body:
Location: internal/tasks/wire error helpers that annotate or wrap a wire.Error. Observed: wrapping an error with the annotating helpers drops the NotRetryable flag, so retryability is lost. Expected: the flag survives annotation.

Source: batch 4 lanes for GitHub #641-#647, 2026-10-06 (branches claude/v1-0645-audit-outside-lock, claude/scale-tasks-v1-0893, claude/scale-core-v1-0416, claude/gh644-live-upgrade). Darwin 25.6.0, go1.27.1. Versions: corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202; corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360).
